text: @dsh-ark-agent/coding-plan 是一个面向 DSH 的火山方舟 Ark Coding Plan 模型接入插件，通过 bundle patch 将 Ark Coding Plan provider 配置到 DSH 的模型提供方列表，并提供 15 个模型及各自的输入类型和推理强度选项。用户可在模型设置中选择这些模型，按任务调整推理档位。插件入口只负责出现在 DSH 插件列表中，实际接入由声明式配置完成。使用需要配置 ARK_CODING_PLAN_CN_API_KEY，模型请求发送到火山方舟接口。

@dsh-ark-agent/coding-plan connects 15 Volcengine Ark Coding Plan models to DSH through a bundle patch. Users can select a configured model and choose its reasoning effort. The plugin declares model input types and sends requests to the Ark provider. It requires ARK_CODING_PLAN_CN_API_KEY.
我想在 DSH 里调用火山方舟 Coding Plan 的模型。
能不能让 DSH 支持 Ark 上的多种编程模型？
I need to switch reasoning levels for models served through Volcengine Ark in DSH.

@dsh-ark-agent/coding-plan README · ⚠️ 装之前先看这一条：本包**整体替换** `llm-pi-ai` 这一行的 `config`（DSH 的 patch 语义是「整体替换、不深合并」）。

- **在设置页 / `settings.yaml` 里配过别的 provider** → 不受影响（那里是深合并）。
- **在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里手写过 pi-ai provider** → 会被替换，请先合并：

```sh
  node scripts/merge.mjs ~/.dsh/profiles/<你的 profile>/cordis.patch.yml
  ```

默认**只打印**结果；确认无误后加 `--write` 落盘（会先备份 `.bak-merge-<时间戳>`）。
  合并助手只做文本级插入，**你的注释会保留**；键冲突时保留你原来的值，不会静默覆盖。

@dsh-ark-agent/coding-plan README · 诚实性说明：> 本包只发布能实测的东西。
>
> **实测的**：每个模型可达、被接受的 `maxTokens` 上限、是否接受图片输入 —— 方法见
> `scripts/probe.mjs`，日期见上表。
>
> **未实测的**：`contextWindow`。验证它需要发送超长 prompt，成本不可控，所以表中没有列出，
> 它在 `models.yml` 里只作为**声明值**存在。
>
> **故意不做的**：Agent Plan / 后付费 / BytePlus 路由。我们没有这些端点的 key，无法验证，
> 因此不写进描述 —— 把没验证过的路由写进去，是收录规则里最容易被退回的一件事。
>
> **怎么保持不过期**：`models.yml` 是唯一数据源，每周 GitHub Action 自动探测模型下架与新品上线
> （候选清单在 `watchlist.yml`，人工维护，不保证覆盖所有新模型）。

@dsh-ark-agent/coding-plan README · 为什么只有一个 patch：DSH 的 patch 语义是「整体替换、不深合并」，所以本包只能**覆盖** `llm-pi-ai` 那一行。

早期版本试过「`insert` 一个同插件的第二行」，**已实测证伪**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 会
无条件把整套 catalog 注册进 `dsh-llm` 的**单例** configurable-provider 目录，第二个实例必然报：

```
llm-pi-ai-ark-coding (@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai): LlmError:
  configurable provider "amazon-bedrock" is already declared
```

而 `dsh-base` 总是先挂一行 `llm-pi-ai`，所以第二行在任何机器（含全新 profile）都无法激活，
与 provider 名字是否重名无关。

@dsh-ark-agent/coding-plan README · ⚠️ Read this before installing：This package **replaces the whole `config`** of the `llm-pi-ai` row (DSH patches replace config
wholesale and do not deep-merge).

- Providers you added through the settings UI / `settings.yaml` are **not** affected (those deep-merge).
- Providers you hand-wrote into your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` **would** be replaced — merge first:

```sh
  node scripts/merge.mjs ~/.dsh/profiles/<your profile>/cordis.patch.yml
  ```

@dsh-ark-agent/coding-plan README · ⚠️ Read this before installing：It only prints by default; add `--write` to save (a `.bak-merge-<ts>` backup is made first).
  The merge is a textual insertion, so **your comments survive**; on a key conflict your existing
  value wins and you are told, never silently overwritten.

@dsh-ark-agent/coding-plan README · Models and measured data：- The `maxTokens` probes step through 65536 / 131072 / 262144 / 393216; the table shows the
  **highest value the endpoint accepted**.
- `glm-5.3` and `glm-5.3-flash` have **no `off`**: turning thinking off for these returns HTTP 400,
  so the level is not offered.
- Thinking tokens are billed as output, so a higher reasoning level costs noticeably more.

@dsh-ark-agent/coding-plan README · Honesty statement：> This package only ships what can be measured.
>
> **Measured**: that each model is reachable, the `maxTokens` value the endpoint accepts, and whether
> it accepts image input — the method is `scripts/probe.mjs`, the date is above.
>
> **Not measured**: `contextWindow`. Verifying it needs an oversized prompt, whose cost is not
> bounded, so it is absent from the table and exists in `models.yml` only as a **claimed** value.
>
> **Deliberately not done**: Agent Plan, postpaid and BytePlus routes. We hold no key for those
> endpoints and cannot verify them, so they are not described. Shipping unverified routes is the
> single fastest way to get an otherwise-good plugin sent back.
>
> **How it stays current**: `models.yml` is the single source, and a weekly GitHub Action probes for
> retired models and newly available ones (candidates live in `watchlist.yml`, maintained by hand and
> not guaranteed to catch every new model).

@dsh-ark-agent/coding-plan README · Why there is only one patch：DSH patches replace config wholesale and do not deep-merge, so this package can only **override**
the `llm-pi-ai` row.

An earlier version tried `insert`-ing a second row for the same plugin. That was **measured and
disproved**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` unconditionally registers its entire catalog into
`dsh-llm`'s **singleton** configurable-provider registry, so a second instance always fails with:
section: Why there is only one patch

text:
@dsh-ark-agent/coding-plan README · Why there is only one patch：```
llm-pi-ai-ark-coding (@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai): LlmError:
  configurable provider "amazon-bedrock" is already declared
```

`dsh-base` always mounts one `llm-pi-ai` row first, so the second row cannot activate on any machine
— a fresh profile included — regardless of whether the provider name collides.
